findings.text: The operations and ERROR states are supported, but "returns an error span received by both" confuses telemetry records with an error response. Describe separately the checkout client span and payment server/internal spans; do not call an emitted span a received RPC error payload.

The suggested inspection target has a defensible basis, but the event-level span rationale is broader than its own citations. Add the actual payment server/internal span citations and distinguish the incident-window aggregate from the particular request; retain the priority as provisional.

The root-cause caveat is supported; specific proposed mechanisms are not sourced system knowledge merely because "could" is used. Place these in explicitly unverified hypothesis/uncertainty text with a discriminating check, or omit them. Verify dependency existence before health inspection.

limitations: Three inspected development questions, one incident. This review is not domain-expert certification or a student judgment.
